source.manualTitle: Whirlpool 7.0 cu. ft. Gas & Electric Dryers Technical Manual (WED4100/WGD4100)

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Door-open drum light
steps.body: Open door — drum light should illuminate. If not, access ACU and drum light harness.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Open door — drum light should illuminate. If not, access ACU and drum light harness.

steps.title: Harness continuity
steps.body: Power off. Check harness and inline connections between drum light and ACU.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Check harness and inline connections between drum light and ACU.

steps.title: J7-3 to J7-4 with door open
steps.body: Ohms at ACU J7 pins 3–4, door open: expect 10 Ω–1.44 kΩ (bulb good). Door closed = OL.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Ohms at ACU J7 pins 3–4, door open: expect 10 Ω–1.44 kΩ (bulb good). Door closed = OL.

branches.label: No / failed
branches.oemOutcome: Replace bulb or door switch per pin-out test at light.

steps.title: Replace bulb or door switch
steps.oemOutcome: Replace drum light bulb; if bulb OK at light, replace door switch.

steps.title: Replace ACU
steps.oemOutcome: Resistance good at board but no light — replace ACU.

steps.title: Drum light verified
steps.oemOutcome: Drum light illuminates when door opens.
